Two operational notes matter: the slow suite needs cached model weights (the DistilBERT emotion checkpoint and `flan-t5-small`) and those tests SKIP (not fail) without them, and the four legacy unittest files can still run standalone via `unittest.main()`.

sections.title: Fixtures and test data
sections.explanation: Where the data lives: `data/sample_chats/` holds real-style exports with locked-in counts (`KNOWN_WHATSAPP_COUNT = 27`), `tests/fixtures/` holds adversarial exports with locked parse-report counters, and `tests/golden/` holds the two parity CSVs from Step 12. There is deliberately no `conftest.py` — most tests build inline data — and all file I/O uses `tmp_path` with `encoding="utf-8"` because the Windows cp1252 console cannot encode the emoji-heavy fixtures. CLI tests run with `cwd=tmp_path` so reports never land in the repo tree.

sections.title: What the suite covers
sections.explanation: The per-area coverage table is the index into the whole suite, linking every test file to the feature it exercises: WhatsApp/Telegram parsers (format variants, honest counters, tz normalization), the canonical DataFrame schema, VADER plus its dedupe/parallel parity, emotion (mocked, plus sampling, parallel scoring, and quarterly aggregation), the result cache's real-`run_pipeline` tests, the summarizer, EDA, relationship health, network, narrative, visualization, interactive ECharts specs, the HTML report, CLI end-to-end, pipeline orchestration, ZIP input, the five perf-parity files, golden parity, the NLP gate, the Windows long-path guard, and packaging smoke. Reading one row tells you which file to open for any behavior.

sections.title: Conventions for new tests
sections.explanation: The house rules, each earned by a past bug: import real modules (never re-implement logic); mock only the heavy callables on the module-level caches (`_emotion_analyzer`, `T5Tokenizer.from_pretrained`); pin `MPLBACKEND=Agg` BEFORE importing chat_analyzer, since importing the emotion module pulls matplotlib and the TkAgg default crashes headless; monkeypatch environment variables so mutations never leak; keep mocked pools sequential with `_FakePool`-style stand-ins — the real multiprocess spawn path runs only in the slow smoke; redirect print-emote stdout on cp1252 consoles; keep reports out of the repo tree; and mark wall-clock-heavy tests `@pytest.mark.slow`.

sections.title: Coverage requirements
sections.explanation: This section states that no minimum coverage thresholds are configured and CI has no coverage step, with `pytest-cov` available for self-service inspection via `--cov=src --cov-report=term-missing`. Worth noticing: the actual `ci.yml` in this repo DOES pass `--cov-fail-under=50` on the lean test job, so this generated section (and the CI table below) lags the workflow slightly — the workflow is the source of truth.

sections.title: CI integration
sections.explanation: Maps the suite onto the three jobs — `test` (the 2×2 OS/Python matrix, base install, fast suite), `slow` (ubuntu/3.11, ruff then the slow suite), and `nlp` (`.[dev,nlp]` install, `test_phase4_nlp.py`) — all with a 30-minute timeout and the same three env vars. It notes the concurrency cancellation and the pinned action versions. The closing caveat is subtle and useful: the slow-marked real-model spawn-parity smoke does NOT run in CI (the slow job has no torch, so the test skips) — it exists as a local verification tool.

src/chat_analyzer/utils/__init__.py.overview: Package barrel for the utilities subpackage that re-exports the text preprocessing helpers and the ChatVisualizer class with an explicit __all__ list.

src/chat_analyzer/utils/preprocessing.py.overview: Computes the fraction of DataFrame messages that are non-Latin-heavy, surfaced in the CLI report as a disclaimer metric via the adapters layer.

src/chat_analyzer/utils/visualization.py.overview: Convenience wrapper that constructs a ChatVisualizer and saves the summary dashboard in a single call.

src/chat_analyzer/ingest/__init__.py.overview: Package barrel for the ingest layer, re-exporting get_dependency_status, get_supported_formats, and process_uploaded_file via an explicit __all__ so callers import the ingestion API directly from chat_analyzer.ingest.

docs/CONFIGURATION.md.overview: Configuration reference explaining that there is no config file: behavior is controlled by the pyproject.toml extras ([nlp]/[dev]), optional environment variables (tier selection, emotion sample/workers/quant knobs, result cache, report auto-open, long-path override) with exact never-raise parsing rules, the Windows MAX_PATH guard, and per-environment behavior tables for local and CI runs.

docs/DEVELOPMENT.md.overview: Developer guide covering local setup and the editable install, running the CLI from a checkout, the full src/chat_analyzer module layout, hard architecture rules (lean base install, lazy imports, headless Agg backend, D-17 test mocking), step-by-step recipes for adding a new parser or analysis feature, and CI, branch, and pull-request conventions.

docs/GETTING-STARTED.md.overview: First-run user guide: prerequisites (Python 3.11+), exporting WhatsApp .txt / Telegram .json / .zip chats, editable install with the optional [nlp] extra, the always-on NLP tier menu, Windows long-path workarounds via the short-path venv script, where the HTML report is written, and common setup issues.

docs/design_incremental_rolling_health.m.overview: Research-only design note for making calculate_rolling_health_score incremental: measured cost breakdown of the current per-window recompute, proof that conversation-starter flags are invariant across a slide, the recommended deque-of-per-day-numpy-segments architecture with a cheap scalar score pass, and a bit-parity pitfalls checklist for float/rounding behavior.

tests/fixtures/telegram_bare_entity.json.overview: Minimal Telegram export fixture with a bare top-level name/type/messages shape (no chats.list wrapper), used by test_phase2_telegram.py to verify the parser handles a chat export without the full-export envelope.

tests/fixtures/telegram_full_export.json.overview: Full-shape Telegram export fixture under a chats.list envelope, mixing normal messages, a service message, a UTC 'Z'-suffixed date, a malformed date, and a forwarded message — the primary edge-case corpus for test_phase2_telegram.py.

tests/fixtures/whatsapp_all_skipped.txt.overview: Three-line plain-text fixture with no WhatsApp timestamp headers at all (a fixture file rather than prose, emitted as a document node per its fileCategory), representing the negative path where every line is skipped and the pipeline must raise a friendly unparseable-input error.

tests/fixtures/whatsapp_system_skip.txt.overview: WhatsApp export fixture combining valid messages with an end-to-end-encryption system line, an unparseable-date line, a continuation line, and a system action line — used by test_phase2_whatsapp.py to verify system messages are counted but not appended as chat rows.

notebooks/01_data_parsing.ipynb.overview: Jupyter notebook prototyping data ingestion: fetches sample chat exports from GitHub and develops the WhatsApp/Telegram parsing logic that was later promoted into the chat_analyzer parser package.

notebooks/02_exploratory_analysis.ipynb.overview: Exploratory-analysis notebook computing message volume, activity patterns, and conversation dynamics; its analysis patterns were later productized as the ChatEDA class in analysis/eda.py.

notebooks/03_sentiment_emotion.ipynb.overview: Prototype notebook for the NLP tier: VADER/TextBlob/HuggingFace sentiment plus six-class emotion classification with quarterly emotion timelines; the origin of analysis/sentiment.py and analysis/emotion.py.

notebooks/04_relationship_health.ipynb.overview: Prototype notebook for relationship-health metrics — conversation initiation, response lag, dominance scores, rolling health, and the gamified friendship index — later productized as analysis/relationship_health.py.

notebooks/05_network_graph.ipynb.overview: Prototype notebook that sets up the environment and imports the network graph module to build interaction networks, compute centrality and community metrics, and render network dashboards.

notebooks/06_summarization.ipynb.overview: Prototype notebook for T5-based conversation summarization with group-chat dynamics analysis; the origin of the ConversationSummarizer in analysis/summarizer.py.

notebooks/07_final_integration.ipynb.overview: Empty placeholder notebook (zero cells) evidently reserved for a final integration walkthrough of the full analysis pipeline.

scripts/benchmark.py.overview: CLI entry point parsing --inputs/--tiers/--json/--log/--timeout flags, orchestrating the fresh-subprocess benchmark runs while skipping missing files with a warning, and writing the final JSON results table.

src/chat_analyzer/__init__.py.overview: Package root declaring version/author metadata, the public submodule list, and a canonical logging NullHandler so analysis-side loggers stay silent instead of leaking tracebacks to stderr on degraded paths.

src/chat_analyzer/analysis/__init__.py.overview: Analysis package barrel that re-exports the relationship-health public API (analyze_relationship_health, calculate_relationship_health_score, plot_relationship_health_dashboard_enhanced) and documents the module map for EDA, sentiment, emotion, and relationship health.

src/chat_analyzer/reporting/__init__.py.overview: Package barrel for the reporting layer, re-exporting ChatAnalysisPDFGenerator and generate_chat_analysis_pdf so callers can use PDF reporting via chat_analyzer.reporting.

src/chat_analyzer/reporting/pdf_report.p.overview: Standalone demo that fabricates sample analysis results and generates a PDF, useful as a manual smoke test of the report layout.

src/chat_analyzer/reporting/weekly_diges.overview: One-shot helper that builds a WeeklyDigestBot from keyword arguments and immediately sends a digest for the given DataFrame to an email recipient and/or Telegram chat.

tests/__init__.py.overview: Empty package marker that makes the tests directory a Python package so pytest can resolve test module imports consistently.

tests/test_analysis.py.overview: Integration checks that plot data preparation and heatmap data structures come out of the analysis in the shape the visualizers expect.

tests/test_eda_parity.py.overview: Parity test on a larger randomized frame, catching vectorization drift that tiny fixtures cannot expose.

tests/test_emotion_parallel.py.overview: End-to-end smoke: spawn-based parallel scoring over a real temp transcript matches the sequential reference result.

tests/test_emotion_quarterly.py.overview: Numpy float values serialize to plain JSON numbers in the timeline spec.

tests/test_emotion_sampling.py.overview: Tokenizer stub returning fixed ids and decodings for T5 pipeline mocks.

tests/test_end_to_end.py.overview: Validates datetime formats, sender names, message content, and score ranges.

tests/test_ingestion_cor02.py.overview: Lines the raw parser already skipped are not double-counted when messages_to_dataframe drops bad rows.

tests/test_interactive_charts.py.overview: A participant named like a script tag is HTML-escaped in the report — an XSS regression guard.

tests/test_long_path_guard.py.overview: install_nlp raises the friendly long-path message instead of proceeding when the venv lives under a deep Windows path.

tests/test_narrative.py.overview: Focused tests on the narrative feature extractors: question-ratio phrasing, message-length asymmetry, exact-alternation reciprocity, and sensitive-topic driver identification.

tests/test_parser.py.overview: Shared edge cases: special characters in names, unicode handling, very long messages, and empty files or exports for both formats.

tests/test_perf_parity.py.overview: Parallel rolling health matches the sequential path exactly when workers are forced on.

tests/test_perf_parity_dynamics.py.overview: Passing precomputed dynamics equals computing them by default in the summary path.

tests/test_perf_parity_emotion.py.overview: transformers-5 returning a whole-batch tensor is wrapped per-text correctly.

tests/test_perf_parity_network.py.overview: run_pipeline computes the interaction network exactly once (memoization guard).

tests/test_perf_parity_sentiment.py.overview: Importing the sentiment module must not load transformers, keeping the lean-base install light.

tests/test_phase1_smoke.py.overview: Reporting modules import successfully but are never invoked anywhere in the CLI path (D-10/D-11 decision).

tests/test_phase2_builder.py.overview: Verifies rows with unparseable datetimes are dropped from the DataFrame while the count of dropped rows is reported honestly.

tests/test_phase2_cli.py.overview: Writes a chat with unparseable lines and asserts the generated report surfaces the skip counts together with the run date.

tests/test_phase2_pipeline.py.overview: Builds a single-message chat and asserts the pipeline tolerates it without fabricating a response-time metric.

tests/test_phase2_report.py.overview: Verifies the Tier-B narrative lead paragraph renders with its hedged phrasing inside the narrative tab of the report.

tests/test_phase2_telegram.py.overview: Feeds timezone-aware Telegram timestamps and asserts every parsed datetime comes back naive and normalized to UTC.

tests/test_phase2_whatsapp.py.overview: Verifies messages with an empty body are kept as real messages instead of being misclassified as system lines.

tests/test_phase4_alwayson.py.overview: Asserts the relationship-health and interaction-network tabs or blocks appear in the report generated by a full CLI run.

tests/test_phase4_cli.py.overview: On non-TTY runs, outdated NLP installs are kept as-is with a notice instead of auto-upgrading.

tests/test_phase4_nlp.py.overview: Asserts the generated report includes emotion and summary tabs populated from the mocked NLP results.

tests/test_phase4_nlp_gate.py.overview: nlp_models_cached reports not-cached unless both the sentiment and summarization models are present.

tests/test_phase4_zip.py.overview: A ZIP containing both WhatsApp .txt and Telegram .json transcripts is parsed with the appropriate parser for each member.

tests/test_phase4_zip_media.py.overview: Asserts the parsed media count is surfaced in the final report for a ZIP containing embedded media.

tests/test_reporting.py.overview: create_digest_bot wires the token, chat id, and week settings into the WeeklyDigestBot configuration correctly.

tests/test_result_cache.py.overview: Loading a cached result resets the report path so a re-run writes a fresh report instead of reusing a stale file.

tests/test_rolling_health_sliding.py.overview: Result dtypes and row ordering match the reference implementation exactly.

tests/test_version_cor01.py.overview: Version-reporting regression tests (COR-01): the CLI falls back gracefully when package metadata is missing and prints a semver when metadata is present.

tests/test_ws_honesty.py.overview: Verifies the honesty disclaimer is appended to insights only when the non-Latin share is high, and that appending keeps insight indices stable.

tests/test_zip_input_cor03.py.overview: A corrupt ZIP member that fails parsing is excluded from the chosen transcript names and honestly reported, per COR-03.
